title: [Independent verification] Apply selected cut-rank bound to centre phase (no new κ)
body:
## Status: independent verification

This package applies the conditional scalar common-frame cut-rank inequality from #1664 to the exact centre phase in selected PR #1094. It replays the selected 480-helper emitted program, establishes a full-rank 704-coordinate Q entry state, and verifies that the eight height-8 carriers scatter into 88 disjoint height-0 targets through a rational 88×8 matrix of rank 8. All eight private copies are cleared inside the measured interval. With no dirty-host endpoint term, the inherited bound is 8·8 = 64 transport units; the emitted phase has exactly eight height-8 descents, also 64.

This adds the selected-source Q-rank and complete copy/descend/scatter/clear boundary application that #1664 explicitly left open. It complements #1643’s F2 nested-tree geometry. It is distinct from merged #1453’s obstruction for final helper climbs through the fixed R480 cleanup: this PR audits the earlier centre phase and makes no helper-cleanup claim. The older #717 result concerns a rebuilt #656 492-helper word.

## Reproduction and pins

From the repository root on Python 3.12:

```sh
python3 -B research/selected-centre-cutrank-seed52/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/selected-centre-cutrank-seed52/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-centre-cutrank-seed52
make selected-record-check
python3 -B scripts/research_baseline.py
```

The first two commands emit `PASS_SELECTED_CENTRE_CUTRANK_APPLICATION centres=8 targets=88 entry_rank_Q=96 rank_Q=8 floor=64 transport=64 controls=7`; the registered replay emits `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`. Both selected baseline commands passed on the rebased head. The experiment base is `418e40eb2572d930b58c1cf9b82b41c0fc7ee08d`; the branch is rebased on current main `5e554ff58d01921747d27177045c0061f31e1ad1`. Selected PR #1094 source head is `0fc329d0bec93ca7cd288eaea1295172e8789810`. Archive and member SHA-256 pins are in `SOURCES.json`.

## Scope and credit

This checks one finite emitted stage under #1664’s written scalar transport model; the verifier does not formalize that universal lemma. The measured 64 is transport mass, not the full ADD/NEG invoice. It gives no new supplier profile, changed implementation, dirty-host credit, production admission, kappa, or multiplication theorem. The accepted record remains `836330098538459/500000000000000000` and complex-binding. Complete selected cold replay and hosted CI were not rerun here.

Credit Rohan Arun and the selected PR #1094 supplier lineage; DreamingOfClouds’ related legacy centre/cut work in #717; Ali Romman and disclosed Codex-assisted work in #1453; Dennis (@antunishdPursuit)’s complementary #1643 audit; and Andrey Mas’s conditional cut-rank proof in #1664. Prepared by Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in scope selection, exact replay code, source handling, and exposition. No independent human review or proof-assistant verification is claimed. New work is Apache-2.0.
